description: Ordered messages of a full two-peer sync driven through y-protocols' readSyncMessage: A starts with 'hello from A', B starts empty. 01: A->B step1 (A's SV). 02: B->A step2 (diff, everything since B is empty). 03: B->A step1 (B's SV, still nothing new). 04: A->B step2 (empty diff, A has nothing new from B). 05: A->B update (broadcast of A's further local edit appending '!!').
